brief: Split src/math.ts into two modules: src/double.ts (exporting double) and src/triple.ts (exporting triple). Update src/index.ts to re-export both from the new modules, then delete src/math.ts. The public API must keep working: test/api.test.ts imports from src/index.ts and must pass untouched. Do not modify anything under test/.
setup: git init -q && git config user.email eval@pi-mini.local && git config user.name eval && git config commit.gpgsign false
accept: test -f src/double.ts && test -f src/triple.ts && ! test -f src/math.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --test test/api.test.ts
